## Summary

Meta-learning algorithm using GPs. General in scope but with molecular property prediction as the primary application.

## My contribution

I had the idea and wrote a prototype algorithm, but Wenlin did the rest of the work.

## Thoughts

(as of 2023-11-24)

I think this is a solid algorithm which could be used for real-life problems,
_if_ there is a relevant meta-dataset.
I would be hesitant to just take our pre-trained model and apply it on a random new problem.
